precedence: DATA_AND_COPY.md, GRAPH_GUIDANCE.md, PDF_SPEC.md and DESIGN_SYSTEM.md take precedence over generated image text or incidental artwork.

policy.owned_artwork: All mapped owned artwork is editable SVG with no embedded raster image. Use SVG sources, not PNG screenshot crops.
policy.decorative_usage: Illustrations are approved motif replacements, not exact tracings of generator-specific strokes. Omit decorative art when accessibility size or task density needs the room.
policy.icons: 24-unit viewBox, currentColor, shared weight. Native target at least 44pt iOS/48dp Android, accessible name supplied by the control.
policy.charts: References contain synthetic data. Recalculate live charts from original values/units and actual dates; accessible values remain text.
policy.source_documents: User reports, camera previews and PDF content are data, not app decoration. Four original fictional vector excerpts are included solely for implementation fixtures.
policy.native_surfaces: OS permissions, authentication, pickers, camera, notifications and share targets are rendered by the platform. Do not recreate their icons, glyphs, app lists or fonts.
policy.pdf: Print pages use vector logos, typography, rules, category bands and chart paths. No full-page ink fill, generated screenshot background or rasterized text.

native_control_definitions.system-chrome: OS status bar, safe areas, gesture/home indicator and accessibility scaling. Do not draw fixed time, signal or battery SVGs into production UI.
native_control_definitions.text-input: Platform-backed editable field, selection menu and appropriate keyboard; preserve labels, entered text and error semantics.
native_control_definitions.secure-input: Platform-backed secure passphrase field with app show/hide action; never bake a secret into an asset.
native_control_definitions.date-picker: Platform date picker or accessible platform-backed calendar, localized and limited by the recorded-date rules.
native_control_definitions.time-picker: Native time picker using the device time zone and locale.
native_control_definitions.selection-controls: Platform-backed checkbox, radio, switch or segmented selection with programmatic labels and states.
native_control_definitions.progress: Native accessible progress indicator; determinate only when actual progress exists; reduced-motion alternative.
native_control_definitions.confirmation-dialog: Native modal/sheet behavior with trapped accessibility focus, labelled destructive action and cancellation.
native_control_definitions.action-sheet: Native presentation/dismissal behavior for contextual app actions; icon artwork is supplied separately.
native_control_definitions.camera-capture: OS camera or platform camera API preview and capture controls; actual viewfinder content comes from the camera.
native_control_definitions.photo-picker: OS photo picker with user-selected originals; do not reproduce its app icons or synthetic thumbnails in production.
native_control_definitions.file-open-picker: OS document-open picker. The OS owns locations, provider icons and file availability.
native_control_definitions.file-save-picker: OS create-document/Save to Files sheet; filename, storage providers and availability come from the platform.
native_control_definitions.camera-permission: OS camera permission alert; app supplies a truthful purpose string, not a custom imitation.
native_control_definitions.notification-permission: OS notification authorization alert. Respect the resulting capability.
native_control_definitions.system-notification: Native lock-screen notification; redact medicine/profile details by default and honor platform lock policy.
native_control_definitions.healthkit-permission: Apple Health authorization, requested read scopes only: steps, heart rate and weight.
native_control_definitions.health-connect-permission: Android Health Connect authorization, requested read scopes only: steps, heart rate and weight.
native_control_definitions.biometric-authentication: OS authentication prompt and available passcode fallback; hide all profile and medical content behind it.
native_control_definitions.share-ios: UIActivityViewController or the supported native share interface; installed targets and file metadata belong to the OS.
native_control_definitions.share-android: Android Sharesheet; recipients and installed apps are generated by the platform.
native_control_definitions.document-renderer: Native/PDF-capable renderer for the actual original or generated document; retain zoom, selection and accessible text where supported.
native_control_definitions.external-settings: Platform settings handoff for device permissions/security; show only actions that the platform supports.
native_control_definitions.external-browser: System browser for verified source-code, license, support or other external links.
native_control_definitions.screen-reader-feedback: Native announcement of result/validation/save state without moving focus unexpectedly.
